windows.intermediate_caption: Two individuals, one in a yellow top and dark pants and another in a light-colored top and dark pants, walk from left to right across the paved area in front of the building labeled "STUDENT SERVICES", passing behind a tall, thin pole. A person in a white shirt and dark pants exits the building through a glass door beneath a green awning and walks from right to left across the paved area. Two people approach the entrance of a building with a green awning from the right side of the frame; both enter the building, after which one individual exits and proceeds leftward, leaving the entrance. A person in a striped shirt walks from left to right in front of the "STUDENT SERVICES" building, passes a green awning marked "CHICANO," and continues off-screen to the right. Another person, wearing a plaid shirt and blue jeans, walks from left to right in front of the "STUDENT SERVICES" building, also passing the "CHICANO"-marked awning before disappearing behind a pole. Subsequently, a different person in a striped shirt and dark pants walks from left to right in front of the "STUDENT SERVICES" building and continues down a paved path away from the camera. Finally, a person in a light-colored shirt and dark pants approaches the entrance of the "STUDENT SERVICES" building from the left, while simultaneously, another person wearing a red hat and a green shirt enters the frame from the lower right and begins walking toward the left.
